description: Etihad Guest Miles and Tier Miles for Etihad-marketed and operated flights on an Etihad ticket (number starting 607, 291 or 169; stock EY). Each route from Abu Dhabi (AUH) has a fixed base number from Etihad's own miles calculator (1,000 to 7,000, not the distance flown); a journey between two other cities is two flights via AUH, each on its own base. Guest Miles = base x fare-brand %, rounded half up: Economy (cabin Y) Basic 5% (15% if issued before 18 June 2026), Value 35, Comfort 75, Deluxe 125; Business (J) Value 100, Comfort 150 (200 if issued before 21 July 2025), Deluxe 250; First (F) Comfort 200 (300 before 21 July 2025), Deluxe 300 (issued: N from 18 Jun 2026, M 21 Jul 2025 to 17 Jun 2026, O before 21 Jul 2025). Tier bonus on paid fares: Silver 25%, Gold 50%, Platinum and Emerald 100% of the base, Guest Miles only. Tier Miles = the same share of the base, no bonus. Promo (award) seats (seat P) earn no Guest Miles; Tier Miles 0 (Value), 25% (Comfort), 50% (Deluxe). A city not on Etihad's list is refused. Other tickets (stock OT) earn by booking class and are not worked out (the message gives the table). Progress toward Silver 25,000, Gold 50,000 and Platinum 125,000 Tier Miles in 12 months (25% less from 18 March 2026 to 31 March 2027 for existing members); tm is the Tier Miles so far. Give segs: one entry per journey, in order, with from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports (required; the base numbers come from the table). Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

brand.description: Fare brand. B = Basic; V = Value; C = Comfort; D = Deluxe. As on your booking. Basic is Economy only; First is Comfort or Deluxe. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

cabin.description: Cabin. Y = Economy; J = Business; F = First. The Residence is not a fare brand in Etihad's tables, so it is not offered. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Etihad Airways's own: american = American AAdvantage (creditStatus one of: AAdvantage member, AAdvantage Gold, AAdvantage Platinum, AAdvantage Platinum Pro, AAdvantage Executive Platinum); aeroplan = Aeroplan (creditStatus one of: Aeroplan Member, 25K, 35K, 50K, 75K, Super Elite); flying-blue = Flying Blue (creditStatus one of: Explorer, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Ultimate). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. Give the flights as creditFlights (one entry per flight with its great-circle miles).

issued.description: Ticket issued. N = From 18 Jun 2026; M = 21 Jul 2025 to 17 Jun 2026; O = Before 21 Jul 2025. Economy Basic earned 15% before 18 June 2026; Business Comfort 200% and First Comfort 300% before 21 July 2025. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

seat.description: Fare type. C = Paid fare; P = Promo seat (award). Promo seats are Etihad's award (miles) seats: no Guest Miles, Tier Miles on Comfort and Deluxe only. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 4): from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports (required: the earn table is keyed by the airport pair); optional fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports.

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. AKL. Required: Air New Zealand's earn table is keyed by the airport pair.

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. AKL. Required: Air New Zealand's earn table is keyed by the airport pair.

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your Etihad Guest tier. BR = Bronze; SI = Silver; GO = Gold; PL = Platinum; EM = Emerald. The tier bonus adds Guest Miles (Silver 25%, Gold 50%, Platinum and Emerald 100% of the base). Tier Miles are the same for everyone. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

stock.description: Ticket number starts with. EY = 607, 291 or 169 (Etihad ticket); OT = Another number (by booking class). Etihad's rates by fare brand apply to Etihad tickets (607, 291 or 169). Other tickets earn by booking class.

tm.description: Tier Miles you have in the last 12 months (optional). Used only for the progress toward Silver, Gold and Platinum. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way. Only applies to some choices of the other fields; ignored otherwise.
